identificationModule.briefTitle: Durvalumab or Placebo in Combination With Gemcitabine/Cisplatin in Patients With 1st Line Advanced Biliary Tract Cancer (TOPAZ-1)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III Randomized, Double-Blind Placebo Controlled, Multi-Regional, International Study of Durvalumab in Combination With Gemcitabine Plus Cisplatin Versus Placebo in Combination With Gemcitabine Plus Cisplatin for Patients With First-Line Advanced Biliary Tract Cancers

designInfo.interventionModelDescription: Durvalumab in Combination with Gemcitabine plus Cisplatin Placebo in Combination with Gemcitabine plus Cisplatin

interventions.name: Durvalumab
interventions.description: IV infusion every 3 weeks with gemcitabine plus cisplatin up to 8 cycles followed by monotherapy every 4 weeks until disease progression or other discontinuation criteria.

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: IV infusion every 3 weeks with gemcitabine plus cisplatin up to 8 cycles followed by monotherapy every 4 weeks until disease progression or other discontinuation criteria.
